title: Phrase TMS workflow configuration
description: Consumer-repository configuration for reusable Phrase submission and reconciliation workflows. Credentials must be provided as protected workflow secrets; the CLI rejects credential-like keys anywhere in this file.

builtInAdapter.description: tms submit and tms reconcile run with Phrase and GitHub write credentials, so they load only the CLI's built-in catalog adapters.

sourceCatalog.description: Phrase source catalog settings. For generated FEO source, the template path is the source input while path remains the logical catalog location.

path.description: Logical repository-relative source catalog path. With frontendTemplate.generateSourceCatalog, the source input is frontendTemplate.path; otherwise this file is read from the repository.

filename.description: Phrase upload filename; defaults to the basename of path. The expected-source-filename workflow pin checks this value and the Phrase jobs. Hub consumers should use a unique filename within the Phrase project.

frontendTemplate.description: Optional Frontend YAML input. Reconciliation inlines each locale into this file; generateSourceCatalog makes it the Phrase source input.

path.description: Repository-relative Frontend YAML path used for source generation when enabled and for locale inlining during reconciliation.

generateSourceCatalog.description: Generate the Phrase source catalog from path on submit and reconciliation instead of reading sourceCatalog.path.

completionPolicy.description: Readiness policy for opening locale PRs. Batch completion is separate: a batch completes when each locale has failed or its PR is merged or closed.

default.description: Readiness policy for target locales without a byLocale override. per-locale opens each ready locale PR independently; all-locales waits until every target locale is ready and blocks sibling PRs if a locale fails. Both policies open one PR per locale.

additionalProperties.description: Readiness policy override for this Phrase locale.
